Subject: Layering: the system that keeps you moving
CTA: Shop the Cascade 45L -> https://northbaysupply.com/products/nb-trk-01
Body: Hey,

You already know the drill. Weather on a three-day trip doesn't stay polite, and comfort comes from how your layers work together — not from any single piece of kit.

Here's the quick version of how to think about it:

**Base layer — move moisture away**
This layer sits against your skin. Its job is to pull sweat away so it can evaporate. Merino wool and synthetic fabrics both work; merino handles odor better on longer trips, synthetics dry faster when you're working hard. Weight and fit matter here — baggy base layers trap cold air and bunch under a shell.

**Mid layer — trap warmth**
Fleece or insulation, depending on conditions. Fleece earns its place in shoulder seasons: breathable, quick-drying, packable enough to clip to the outside of your pack. Down is warmer per gram but loses loft when wet — synthetic fill handles moisture better if you're in maritime or high-humidity terrain. A 100g–200g mid layer covers most three-season use.

**Shell — manage the elements**
The shell doesn't have to be heavy. What it needs to do: block wind, shed rain, and breathe enough that you don't soak yourself from the inside. A shell that doesn't breathe trades one wet problem for another. Know your waterproof rating and what it actually means — a 10,000mm hydrostatic head rating handles sustained rain; a 5,000mm rating handles light showers. Match the spec to your terrain.

**A note on your pack**
Layering applies to your load-out too. If you're carrying the Northbay Cascade 45L (1.4 kg, ripstop nylon, internal frame), keep in mind its shell is water-resistant — not waterproof. That handles light rain and trail splash well. For a full storm day, a pack liner or a dedicated waterproof dry bag inside is the right move. The 45L capacity gives you room to pack a liner without sacrificing space for your layers.

Get your system dialed before the trailhead. The conditions won't wait.

— The Northbay Supply team
